prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Paint one full-size historical character portrait for a Hearts of Iron IV mod, 米哈伊尔·加里宁 (mikhail_kalinin). Image 1 is the ONLY face/identity and clothing reference: extract the actual face from its tiny advisor-card art, discard card border and paper overlay. Images 2 and 3 are STYLE and COMPOSITION references only, NOT their facial identity. Older man with receding swept-back dark-grey hair, small thin round spectacles, long narrow face, moustache and pointed grey beard, high dark collar jacket. Preserve the age and facial identity visible in first image. Reconstruct natural fine facial details faithfully to the low-resolution reference, same age, expression and direction of gaze. Match the supplied completed portraits precisely: realistic softly painted oil / subtly colorized archival photograph, low saturation brown-grey and muted blue-grey clothes, soft upper-left light, fine understated brush texture, restrained contrast. Head-and-shoulders bust, centered, top of head comfortably within frame, shoulders extend to lower corners. Plain warm grey-beige solid background identical to style references, no scene. Vertical canvas aspect 156:210. Intended final 156x210 pixels; render high resolution with clean recognizable face at small size. Opaque painted background, RGBA PNG acceptable. No text, no card, no paper, no border, no emblem frame, no watermark. One portrait only.
